description: Generates a Makefile for a selectable Qt .pro project using QMake after determining QTDIR.
name: qt-qmake-generate-makefile
promptTemplate:
Create and execute the following shell script with `skill_execute`, passing it as `content`. Replace `{{project_file_pro}}` with the selected .pro file path before execution. QTDIR must be detected before running qmake.

```bash
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
PROJECT_FILE_PRO="{{project_file_pro}}"
[ -n "$PROJECT_FILE_PRO" ] && [ "$PROJECT_FILE_PRO" != "{{project_file_pro}}" ] || { echo "Missing project_file_pro" >&2; exit 1; }
find_qmake() {
  if [ -n "${QTDIR:-}" ] && [ -x "$QTDIR/bin/qmake" ]; then echo "$QTDIR/bin/qmake"; return 0; fi
  if command -v qmake >/dev/null 2>&1; then command -v qmake; return 0; fi
  if command -v qmake6 >/dev/null 2>&1; then command -v qmake6; return 0; fi
  for q in "$HOME"/Qt/*/macos/bin/qmake "$HOME"/Qt/*/clang_64/bin/qmake /Applications/Qt/*/macos/bin/qmake /opt/homebrew/opt/qt/bin/qmake /usr/local/opt/qt/bin/qmake; do [ -x "$q" ] && echo "$q" && return 0; done
  return 1
}
QMAKE_BIN="$(find_qmake)" || { echo "qmake not found. Install Qt or set QTDIR." >&2; exit 1; }
export QTDIR="$(cd "$(dirname "$QMAKE_BIN")/.." && pwd)"
export PATH="$QTDIR/bin:$PATH"
PROJECT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "$PROJECT_FILE_PRO")" && pwd)"
PROJECT_FILE="$(basename "$PROJECT_FILE_PRO")"
cd "$PROJECT_DIR"
"$QMAKE_BIN" "$PROJECT_FILE"
```

Return the generated Makefile location and detected QTDIR.
systemInstruction: Use QMake to generate the Makefile for the user-selected .pro file. Detect and export QTDIR first.
triggerPhrases: qt app makefile mit qmake erzeugen
